notes: Small 5-sheet sanitary-service bid set. Quantities transcribed verbatim from the SUMMARY OF QUANTITIES table on Sheet 3 (12 pay items) and cross-checked against the matching leader callouts on the Sheet 4 plan & profile, which agree item for item. Only the four pay items that map to a registered site_plan category (sewer, storm, erosion) are listed: the other eight — aggregate base course, Class D patches, curb & gutter and its removal, pavement marking, PCC sidewalk and sidewalk removal, traffic control — are surfacing/restoration work for which site_plan has no category, so labelling them would force a wrong category rather than measure anything. Completeness is 'partial' for the same reason, and because incidental materials (trench bedding, backfill, restoration) are not pay items and are not enumerated anywhere on the set. Scope note: the proposed water service is marked 'BY OTHERS' (installed by the City of Rockford Water Division per Sheet 4 note 2) and the building-side cleanout is 'PRIVATE (BLDG) CONNECTION BY OTHERS' — neither is this contract's material, but they are drawn, so an extraction that lists them is wrong-but-understandable rather than a hallucination, and they are deliberately left out of `forbidden`.
